page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-4-lssd is an x86_64 instance provisioned with 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores and 31.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.75 GB of RAM per vCPU. Compute is powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor clocked at 2.3 GHz with a 504 MB L3 cache. The CPU features support for advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and Intel AMX matrix extensions. A bundled 402 GB local NVMe SSD provides integrated high-speed scratch storage directly attached to the host, while no discrete GPU hardware is present.

Benchmark results demonstrate solid single-thread performance alongside predictable bounded multi-core scaling. The instance achieved 1,858.0 in Geekbench single-core testing and delivered top-tier results in Geekbench text processing at 2,828.0, reinforced by strong single-threaded gzip compression at 35.55 GB/sec. Conversely, with only 4 vCPUs, multi-core metrics sit in the lower quartile, including a multi-core Geekbench score of 4,215.0 and PassMark database score of 2,088.07. Memory throughput under large uncached read blocks measured 22.46 GB/sec, placing it in the bottom 10 percent, while Redis SET performance reached an average 7.38 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of 402 GB of fast local NVMe storage and a high memory-to-vCPU ratio provides solid value for memory-intensive workloads without incurring extra block storage attachments. However, users should balance the modest raw multi-core throughput and limited uncached memory bandwidth against compute-heavy demands. This instance is best suited for in-memory caching nodes like Redis, intermediate data transformation pipelines, lightweight databases requiring fast local temporary storage, and memory-heavy web services.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-4-lssd is a memory-oriented virtual machine featuring 4 dedicated vCPUs across 2 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor running at 2.3 GHz. The configuration includes 31.0 GB of RAM, a large 504 MB L3 cache, advanced instruction support including AVX-512 and AMX, and a bundled 402 GB local NVMe SSD without discrete GPU accelerators. Benchmarks highlight strong single-threaded string and compression capabilities, reflected by a top-tier Geekbench text processing score of 2,828.0 and 35.55 GB/sec gzip compression throughput. However, raw multi-core compute and uncached memory bandwidth fall into lower percentiles due to the 4-vCPU hardware footprint. With substantial RAM per core and fast local scratch storage, this instance is well suited for memory-intensive caching tiers, lightweight relational databases, and data processing tasks requiring dedicated compute resources.
